nodes.description: mapping(address=>bool) controllers; whitelist checked by onlyController for mint/burn
uint256 public maxSupply; global supply cap, writable by owner via setMaxSupply
ERC20Upgradeable _totalSupply; increased by _mint, decreased by _burn
ERC20Upgradeable _balances mapping; mutated in _transfer/_mint/_burn
ERC20Upgradeable _allowances mapping; allowance arithmetic in transferFrom/burnFrom
OwnableUpgradeable _owner; gate for onlyOwner privileged functions
PausableUpgradeable _paused flag; whenNotPaused blocks token movement
msg.sender used for controller and owner authorization checks
initialize() sets METASHOT name/symbol, owner, and maxSupply=40000000000 ether; guarded by initializer
mint(address to,uint256 amount) onlyController; enforces amount+totalSupply()<=maxSupply then _mint
burn(address from,uint256 amount) onlyController; forwards to _burn
pause() onlyOwner; sets _paused=true
unpause() onlyOwner; sets _paused=false
setMaxSupply(uint256 maxSupply_) external onlyOwner; rewrites the supply cap
addController(address) external onlyOwner; grants mint/burn rights
removeController(address) external onlyOwner; revokes mint/burn rights
_beforeTokenTransfer hook, overridden in MetashotToken with whenNotPaused
_authorizeUpgrade(address) internal onlyOwner override; access control for UUPS upgrades
_transfer(address,address,uint256) internal; balance checks then _balances writes
_mint(address,uint256) internal; increases _totalSupply and recipient balance
_burn(address,uint256) internal; decreases account balance and _totalSupply
transferFrom(address sender,address recipient,uint256 amount); allowance check, _transfer, allowance decrement
upgradeTo(address newImplementation) external onlyProxy; _authorizeUpgrade then delegatecall upgrade
arithmetic expression amount+totalSupply() compared with maxSupply in mint (overflow of supplied values)
_balances[recipient] += amount style balance mutation inside unchecked blocks
_totalSupply += amount / _totalSupply -= amount arithmetic on total supply
delegatecall to owner-supplied newImplementation during UUPS upgrade (_upgradeToAndCallSecure)
to address parameter of mint
amount parameter of mint, constrained by maxSupply check
amount parameter of burn
from address parameter of burn (account debited)
maxSupply_ parameter of setMaxSupply
controller address parameter of addController
controller address parameter of removeController
newImplementation address parameter of upgradeTo
recipient parameter of transferFrom flow
amount parameter of transferFrom compared against allowance
currentAllowance local read from _allowances in transferFrom
senderBalance local read from _balances in _transfer

amount is the burn argument forwarded to _burn
from is the burn argument selecting the account to debit
maxSupply_ is the sole argument assigned to the maxSupply state variable
controller is the address key written into the controllers mapping
controller is the address key cleared in the controllers mapping
newImplementation is the upgrade target passed to _authorizeUpgrade and the delegatecall path
spender/recipient argument used only in the transferFrom flow
amount argument used only for the transferFrom allowance check and decrement
